name: project-workflow
description: An approval-gated workflow for complex software projects, with optional native Codex agent orchestration, durable progress, validation, and delivery evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, approve, and safely execute complex software work.
interface.longDescription: Project Workflow separates planning from implementation, waits for explicit approval, and then executes the approved scope either coordinator-first or with native Codex agents when parallel work is safe and beneficial. It preserves progress, validates changes, supports Git and non-Git repositories, and records recovery and delivery evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Project Workflow for this complex software task: create a durable plan, wait for my explicit approval, then execute the approved scope with safe coordinator or native-agent orchestration.
